items.name: prod0-main-inventory-refresh
items.command: uv run python -m agentplane.cli host inventory prod0-main --repo-root /root/work/AgentPlane
items.notes: Keeps the tracked inventory snapshot in sync with prod0-main governance assertions.

items.name: prod0-main-host-audit
items.command: uv run python -m agentplane.cli host audit prod0-main --repo-root /root/work/AgentPlane

items.name: prod0-main-network-audit
items.command: uv run python -m agentplane.cli host network audit prod0-main --repo-root /root/work/AgentPlane

items.name: prod0-main-projection-ledger-refresh
items.command: uv run python -m agentplane.cli projection ledger refresh --target prod0-main --repo-root /root/work/AgentPlane --write
items.notes: Refreshes projection-ledger artifacts so verification/ledger references remain current for upgrade prechecks.
